name: Funeral services and graveyard administration
sector: 7.M Digital economy, social and public sector

problems.words: Calls come at any hour and the on-call person sometimes doesn't pick up
quick_ideas: Set a clear on-call rota with a named backup for every night
Share it with all staff, so everyone knows who is responsible.

workzap_build.text: a round-the-clock WhatsApp intake line that routes each request to the on-call person and escalates if not acknowledged.

problems.ask_first: How do families reach you when someone passes away?
problems.free_stops: The routing and escalation rules are set out in the solution document.

problems.words: Two families booked for the same hearse at the same time
quick_ideas: Keep one schedule for all vehicles that only one person updates
Check it before confirming any time with a family.

workzap_build.text: a vehicle and cold-storage scheduling board that shows availability and blocks double-booking.

problems.free_stops: The board set-up is detailed in the solution document.

problems.words: Cold storage unit broke down and we only found out late
quick_ideas: Check and note the cold-storage temperature at fixed times each day
Book servicing before the summer heat.

workzap_build.text: a maintenance log for vehicles and cold storage with service reminders and temperature alerts.

problems.free_stops: The check routine and alert levels go in the solution document; body-handling rules are for the health authority.

problems.words: We run out of kafan cloth or coffins at the worst moment
quick_ideas: Decide a minimum level for each supply item and count once a week
Keep a second supplier contact ready.

workzap_build.text: a supply tracker for shrouds, coffins and washing materials with reorder alerts.

problems.free_stops: The reorder levels and tracker are prepared in the solution document.

problems.words: The graveyard register is an old book; no one knows which plots are free
quick_ideas: Walk one section and mark plots as available, reserved or occupied, without names
Make one person responsible for every new allotment.

workzap_build.text: a digital graveyard register with plot status and an allocation workflow, access restricted by role.

problems.free_stops: The register design and allocation flow are set out in the solution document.

quick_ideas: Require every allotment to be checked against the register before confirming
Note each allotment the same day it is made.

workzap_build.text: an allocation step that checks plot status first and locks a plot once allotted.

problems.free_stops: The allocation rules go in the solution document.

problems.words: Cash payments and donations are not properly recorded
quick_ideas: Give a written receipt for every payment and donation
Count and record cash at the close of each day with two people.

workzap_build.text: a payment and donation register with receipts and a daily cash close.

problems.free_stops: The register and cash close routine are detailed in the solution document.

problems.words: Families keep calling for updates and staff are stretched
quick_ideas: Give each family one staff contact for the whole process
Update the family's chosen contact at each key step without waiting for calls.

workzap_build.text: gentle, automatic status messages to the family's chosen contact at each step.

problems.free_stops: The steps and message wording are prepared in the solution document.

problems.words: Gravediggers and washers paid daily cash with no record
quick_ideas: Note each day's work and payment in one register, signed by the worker
Total it weekly so the committee can see it.

workzap_build.text: a staff rota and on-call calendar with daily wage records.

problems.free_stops: The rota and wage record set-up go in the solution document.

problems.words: Committee can't see monthly numbers of services, income and expenses
quick_ideas: Agree the few numbers the committee needs each month
Prepare them once from the registers for last month.

workzap_build.text: a monthly committee report of services handled, income, expenses and plots remaining.

problems.free_stops: The report layout and inputs are set out in the solution document.

never_say: Any advice on religious rites — say "please ask your scholars or faith leaders".
Advice on death registration, permits, repatriation law, embalming or infection control — say "check with the relevant authority".
Anything about falsified documents, bypassing permits, illegal plot sales or encroachment.
Asking for names, cause of death, IDs, medical details or grave locations of named people.
Rushing or anything that sounds careless about grief; if a death is suspicious or an emergency, say to contact police or emergency services first.

sample_reply.person: Hum trust ka qabristan chalate hain. Register purana hai aur kabhi ek qabar do dafa allot ho jati hai. Koi hal batayein.
sample_reply.pi: Ji haan, is ka hal mumkin hai, aur yeh nazuk kaam aaram se sambhala ja sakta hai. 1) Ek hissa chal kar dekhein aur har plot ko khali, reserved ya bhara hua note karein, naam ke baghair. 2) Har naya allotment register se check karne ke baad hi pakka karein aur usi din likhein. Workzap yeh kaam aap ke liye automatically kar sakta hai: digital register jahan har plot ka status nazar aaye aur allot hote hi woh plot lock ho jaye. Kya main aap ke liye solution document aur quote banwa doon? Mana bhi kar sakte hain.
